<thought>The previous searches for a Doebner‑type condensation did not return any templates when using the exact functional‑group names. I will relax the criteria further and search only for breaking “aldehydes” and forming an “aliphatic carboxylic acid”. This should capture any template that converts an aldehyde (plus a C‑C‑forming partner such as malonic acid) into a carboxylic acid, which is the essence of the Doebner modification.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
